Excellent Italian cuisine
May 2016 • Couples
The menu is Italian. However there is definitely the chef's twist on things. Every time I have been, the meat has been cooked as I requested. The pasta is maybe cooked just a little bit over al dente, and the squid ink pasta is very tasty. Pappardelle and also fresh.
 
Service has been a bit hit and miss. Everybody is pleasant, but there has been a few times where we had to wait. A bit of improvement on that side and it will make the experience so much better.

Awesome view, good food
Jun 2016 • Business
Visited during Ramadan, we had their open buffet offering. The view is to die for, and the service is exceptional. The open buffet had a wide selection of choices to cater to plenty of tastes, and there was a good selection of both local and international cuisines.

I'm not sure what their normal menu looks like, but my experience so far guarantees them a repeat visit the next time I'm in Tunisia.
